title.zh: 仪潘橘 · 后台准备与双资源爆发
title.en: Yixuan / Pan / Fufu · off-field setup and dual-resource burst

summary.zh: 潘反向快支给仪玄，福福后台补失衡；仪玄按实际闪能、术法与喧响安排兑现。
summary.en: Pan assists backward into Yixuan while Fufu supplies off-field Daze. Yixuan spends actual Adrenaline, Technique and Decibels.

conditions.zh: 循环站位为仪玄→潘→福福，旋转等价；潘的上一位必须是仪玄。
conditions.en: Use cyclic order Yixuan → Pan → Fufu; rotations are equivalent. Yixuan must be immediately before Pan.

conditions.zh: 采用2.0作者教学方法并交叉固定3.3技能；未实测当前危局敌人的最优时轴。
conditions.en: Uses authored 2.0 methods cross-checked against fixed 3.3 skills; no current Deadly Assault boss timing is proven optimal.

conditions.zh: 默认0影无专武可执行；不把未选择的套装、虎啸、气绝或通窍自动视为已生效。
conditions.en: Executable at M0 without signatures. Unspecified sets, Tiger’s Roar, Depleted Qi and Meridian Flow are not assumed active.

conditions.zh: 只继承已交叉核对的招式方法，不继承旧攻略的伤害排名、最高分或固定耗时结论。
conditions.en: Only cross-checked action methods are retained, not old damage rankings, score claims or fixed-duration conclusions.

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 仪玄循环教学（2.0）
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Yixuan rotation (2.0)

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 潘引壶快支与合轴（2.0）
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Pan assist and overlap (2.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 仪壶福站位与后台循环（2.0）
label.en: Little Orange · Yixuan/Pan/Fufu order and support loop (2.0)

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先补后台资源，经潘的快支把通窍交给仪玄。
objective.en: Set up off-field resources and transfer Meridian Flow through Pan’s Quick Assist.

title.zh: 福福有能量时补威风，再离场
title.en: Refresh Fufu’s Might when energy permits, then leave

input.zh: 强化特殊技，动作完成后普通切潘
input.en: EX Special; finish the move, then switch normally to Pan

trigger.zh: 能量足够，且需要补威风／威势；没有能量可先留在后台。
trigger.en: Enough energy and a refresh of Might/Momentum is needed. Otherwise keep Fufu off field.

complete.zh: 获得本招资源后切出；虎威实际命中且后台威风达标，才确认虎啸触发。
complete.en: Switch out after gaining the move’s resources. Confirm Tiger’s Roar only after a qualifying off-field Hu Wei hit with sufficient Might.

reason.zh: 作者把福福作为短暂补资源的后台击破；一次EX的80威风不等于已达到100或虎啸自动生效。
reason.en: The author uses Fufu for brief resource refreshes and off-field Daze. One EX’s 80 Might alone does not prove 100 Might or an active Tiger’s Roar.

fallback.zh: 能量不足跳过本招；等待合法招架或实际回能，不假定开局有虎啸。
fallback.en: Skip if energy is insufficient; use a valid Defensive Assist or actual energy recovery rather than assuming the opening buff.

signal.zh: 本招完成后普通切潘；不是快支。
signal.en: After this move finishes, switch normally to Pan; this is not Quick Assist.

title.zh: 潘EX命中 → 上一位仪玄快支
title.en: Pan EX hit → previous-slot Yixuan Quick Assist

input.zh: 强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠
input.en: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike

trigger.zh: 能量足够、目标可命中；仪玄必须是潘的上一位。若通窍仍足够覆盖本轮，可跳过刷新。
trigger.en: Enough energy and a hittable target; Yixuan must occupy Pan’s previous slot. Skip the refresh if Meridian Flow already covers this window.

complete.zh: 命中并看到仪玄的快支提示后接手；不要普通切人冒充获得通窍。
complete.en: Hit and respond to Yixuan’s Quick Assist prompt; do not count a normal switch as obtaining Meridian Flow.

reason.zh: 该技能指定上一位快支；破劲允许潘在接手后继续攻击，通窍授予对应入场者。
reason.en: The skill calls the previous slot. Break Force lets Pan keep attacking after the handoff, while Meridian Flow goes to the qualifying entrant.

fallback.zh: 缺能量先恢复；可以用当前可用点穴技挂气绝，但不能据此认为获得了通窍。
fallback.en: Recover energy if needed. An available pressure-point Special may apply Depleted Qi, but does not establish Meridian Flow by itself.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

signal.zh: 按提示快速支援接仪玄（潘的上一位）。
signal.en: Quick Assist into Yixuan, Pan’s previous slot, on the prompt.

title.zh: 仪玄通过潘的快支入场
title.en: Yixuan enters through Pan’s Quick Assist

input.zh: 出现潘的快支提示时按支援键
input.en: Press Assist on Pan’s matching Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 上一招已命中并触发对应提示；普通切回不满足这项前提。
trigger.en: Pan’s preceding hit triggered the matching prompt; a normal switch does not satisfy this condition.

complete.zh: 确认仪玄入场并获得通窍；潘的自动点穴命中后再确认气绝。
complete.en: Confirm Yixuan’s entry and Meridian Flow; verify Depleted Qi after Pan’s automatic pressure-point hits.

reason.zh: 这里同时安排仪玄接战和潘的脱手续招，不假定后续整段都与潘重叠。
reason.en: This pairs Yixuan’s entry with Pan’s continuing attacks, without assuming Pan overlaps the entire later sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就跳过快支事件；按实际增益重新决定输出或回潘补状态。
fallback.en: Without the prompt, skip this assist event and recheck buffs before damage or another Pan setup.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

label.zh: 破劲自动点穴 · 尚有破劲且动作未结束
label.en: Automatic pressure-point attacks · while Break Force and the move remain

title.zh: 仪玄消耗闪能，积累术法值
title.en: Spend Adrenaline and build Technique Points

input.zh: 强化特殊技 → 衔接特殊技；闪能足够再接第三段
input.en: EX Special → Special follow-up; add the third hit only with enough Adrenaline

trigger.zh: 本招所需闪能足够；需要格挡时按敌人真实攻击时机操作。
trigger.en: Enough Adrenaline for the move; time a block against an actual enemy attack.

complete.zh: 关键命中和可用后续完成，查看实际术法值；第三段需要额外20闪能。
complete.en: Complete the key hits and available follow-ups, then read actual Technique Points. The third hit needs another 20 Adrenaline.

reason.zh: 作者用强化技连段兼顾出伤与术法积累；不能把固定连段次数当作资源必满。
reason.en: The author uses the EX string for damage and Technique buildup; a fixed number of strings does not prove full resources.

fallback.zh: 缺闪能先利用实际闪避／支援回能；分支未满足时停止，不空按第三段。
fallback.en: Recover through actual dodges or assists if needed. Stop when a branch is unavailable instead of forcing the third hit.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 按状态到期补潘／福福，仪玄维持闪能→术法→玄墨的循环。
objective.en: Refresh Pan/Fufu when needed and cycle Yixuan’s Adrenaline → Technique → Auric Ink.

prep.zh: 虎啸／威势需要补时，按开局的福福步骤合法刷新；增益仍足够时跳过重复切人。
prep.en: Use the opening Fufu refresh if Tiger’s Roar/Momentum need it; skip repeated switching while buffs already cover the rotation.

prep.zh: 临近实际失衡可保留已经攒好的术法终结技；离窗口尚远按需兑现，不把本段与爆发段强制连续执行。
prep.en: Reserve ready Technique near an actual Stun opportunity; otherwise spend as needed. Do not force this phase and burst back to back.

title.zh: 术法值达标，施放符法千重
title.en: With enough Technique, cast Endless Talisman Suppression

input.zh: 术法终结技；两种资源同时够时按Q优先释放本招
input.en: Technique Ultimate; when both resources suffice, Ultimate prioritizes this move

trigger.zh: 术法值实际达到120；爆发阶段还需敌人确实可输出、前置增益有效。
trigger.en: Actual Technique Points are at least 120; in a burst phase the target must be hittable and setup buffs active.

complete.zh: 消耗术法值并获得玄墨值；再检查喧响终结技是否就绪。
complete.en: Spend Technique and gain an Auric Ink Point, then check whether the Decibel Ultimate is ready.

reason.zh: 两种终结技使用不同资源。作者建议资源均够时在窗口连续兑现，不代表每轮天然双Q。
reason.en: The two Ultimates use different resources. The author cashes out both when ready in a window; every rotation is not automatically a double Ultimate.

fallback.zh: 术法不足可先用合法强化技补资源；不要把普通终结技当作这次术法消耗。
fallback.en: Use available EX moves to build Technique if short; do not treat the Decibel Ultimate as this Technique spend.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

title.zh: 有玄墨值才用极阵回闪能
title.en: Use Auric Array only with Auric Ink

input.zh: 持有玄墨值时长按闪避
input.en: Hold Dodge while holding an Auric Ink Point

trigger.zh: 实际持有至少1点玄墨值；优先确认前置术法Q确实释放。
trigger.en: At least one actual Auric Ink Point; verify that the preceding Technique Ultimate really executed.

complete.zh: 引导极阵恢复闪能，动作结束自动青溟震击；依据实际回能继续。
complete.en: Channel Array to restore Adrenaline; its ending performs the follow-up attack. Continue from actual recovered resources.

reason.zh: 这是资源恢复步骤，不是免费补满；作者允许双Q后衔接，在窗口仍在时再凝云术。
reason.en: This restores resources rather than granting a free full refill. The author follows double Ultimates with it and uses Cloud-Shaper if the window remains.

fallback.zh: 无玄墨值就回到合法强化技与资源恢复；不要把普通长闪的墨影凝云当作玄墨极阵。
fallback.en: Without Auric Ink, return to available EX moves and recovery; ordinary held Dodge is not Auric Array.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 窗口前补增益；资源均够才双Q，随后极阵回能与凝云术。
objective.en: Refresh before the window; use both Ultimates only when both resources suffice, then Array and Cloud-Shaper.

prep.zh: 前两步属于窗口前准备；通窍已覆盖时可略过。连携提示出现时可选仪玄入场，但本方案不自动制造双连携或固定锁条。
prep.en: The first two events are pre-window setup and can be skipped if Meridian Flow already covers it. Select Yixuan on an actual Chain prompt; this plan does not manufacture double Chains or fixed Stun locks.

title.zh: 喧响终结技已就绪，再接青溟云影
title.en: Follow with the Decibel Ultimate only when ready

trigger.zh: 喧响达到实际释放门槛、目标可命中，爆发窗口仍在；上一个术法Q并不保证这项资源已满。
trigger.en: Decibels meet the actual cost, the target is hittable, and the window remains open. The preceding Technique Ultimate does not guarantee this resource is ready.

complete.zh: 终结技结算后，按玄墨值决定能否接玄墨极阵。
complete.en: After the Ultimate resolves, inspect Auric Ink before choosing Auric Array.

reason.zh: 福福的回喧响可帮助周转，仍按实际数值判断；双Q后接极阵是作者的资源闭环。
reason.en: Fufu’s Decibel return aids cycling but actual resources still govern availability. The author follows available double Ultimates with Array to close the resource loop.

fallback.zh: 未就绪直接跳过；如果仍有玄墨值就进入下一步，不为凑Q空等。
fallback.en: Skip when unavailable. Proceed to Array if Auric Ink exists instead of waiting idle for an Ultimate.

input.en: Hold Dodge while holding an Auric Ink Point

trigger.zh: 实际持有至少1点玄墨值；优先确认前置术法Q确实释放。
trigger.en: At least one actual Auric Ink Point; verify that the preceding Technique Ultimate really executed.

complete.zh: 引导极阵恢复闪能，动作结束自动青溟震击；依据实际回能继续。
complete.en: Channel Array to restore Adrenaline; its ending performs the follow-up attack. Continue from actual recovered resources.

reason.zh: 这是资源恢复步骤，不是免费补满；作者允许双Q后衔接，在窗口仍在时再凝云术。
reason.en: This restores resources rather than granting a free full refill. The author follows double Ultimates with it and uses Cloud-Shaper if the window remains.

fallback.zh: 无玄墨值就回到合法强化技与资源恢复；不要把普通长闪的墨影凝云当作玄墨极阵。
fallback.en: Without Auric Ink, return to available EX moves and recovery; ordinary held Dodge is not Auric Array.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

title.zh: 窗口仍在且闪能足够，再用凝云术
title.en: Cloud-Shaper if the window and Adrenaline remain

trigger.zh: 闪能足够，敌人仍在攻击范围内；本爆发分支要求实际失衡窗口尚未结束。
trigger.en: Enough Adrenaline and the enemy remains in range; this burst branch requires an actual remaining Stun window.

complete.zh: 持续命中后确认收束爆炸结算，再转入下一轮；不假定移动BOSS一直待在球内。
complete.en: Confirm the sustained hits and closing explosion before the next cycle; a moving boss is not assumed to stay inside.

reason.zh: 作者建议用剩余窗口兑现凝云术，常态则以强化技格挡连段维持资源。
reason.en: The author spends remaining window time on Cloud-Shaper, using EX/block strings for ordinary resource cycling.

fallback.zh: 窗口结束或敌人离开范围就回常态；资源不够不强接。
fallback.en: Return to the regular loop if the window closes or the enemy leaves; do not force it without resources.

label.zh: 虎威自动攻击 · 未被福福使用且实际命中时
label.en: Hu Wei auto-attacks · while not used by Fufu and actually hitting

text.zh: 仪玄1影开战获得120术法值，可提前选择术法Q；这不是每轮赠送。
text.en: Yixuan M1 grants 120 Technique at battle start, enabling an earlier Technique Ultimate; the grant does not repeat each loop.

text.zh: 仪玄2影：青溟云影只对实际失衡目标延长一次失衡；符法千重后聚墨派生需按对应招式及按键条件触发。
text.en: Yixuan M2: the Decibel Ultimate extends an actual Stun once; the Technique Ultimate’s extra EX branch still requires its stated preceding move and input.

text.zh: 仪玄6影：青溟云影获得调息时，可额外无视术法值用一次符法千重；受30秒触发间隔限制，不视为常驻免费Q。
text.en: Yixuan M6: when the Decibel Ultimate grants Regulated Breathing, one Technique Ultimate may ignore its resource cost, subject to the 30-second trigger limit; it is not a permanent free Ultimate.

text.zh: 福福1影初始100威风；仍需后台虎威命中等条件触发虎啸，不把进场资源当作已触发增益。
text.en: Fufu M1 starts with 100 Might; the actual off-field Hu Wei hit is still needed to establish Tiger’s Roar.

text.zh: 福福2影可由队友终结技补威势，减少补资源切人；仍查看实际威风和虎啸。
text.en: Fufu M2 gains Momentum from allied Ultimates, reducing refresh switches; still inspect actual Might and Tiger’s Roar.

text.zh: 潘2影延长气绝并按消耗破劲回能，不会让未命中的点穴自动挂上增益。
text.en: Pan M2 extends Depleted Qi and restores energy from Break Force consumption; it does not apply the effect on a missed attack.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.福福有能量时补威风，再离场: 强化特殊技结束后普通切潘
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.潘EX命中 → 上一位仪玄快支: 强化特殊技命中，等仪玄快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.仪玄通过潘的快支入场: 看到仪玄快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.仪玄消耗闪能，积累术法值: 强化特殊技起手，用特殊技续段
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.窗口仍在且闪能足够，再用凝云术: 窗口仍在、闪能足够时长按普攻发动强化特殊技

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技，动作完成后普通切潘: 能量足够时按强化特殊技。动作完成后普通切给潘引壶。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技：贴山震脉靠: 能量足够时按强化特殊技命中目标；看到仪玄的快速支援提示后再接。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.出现潘的快支提示时按支援键: 看到仪玄的快速支援提示，按对应支援键入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技 → 衔接特殊技；闪能足够再接第三段: 按强化特殊技起手，再按特殊技接第二段；还有20点闪能才接第三段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.术法终结技；两种资源同时够时按Q优先释放本招: 术法值达到120时按终结技。两种终结技均可用时，这一按优先消耗术法值。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.持有玄墨值时长按闪避: 至少有1点玄墨值时，长按闪避键引导攻击、恢复闪能。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技：青溟云影: 看仪玄自己的喧响值；喧响终结技就绪后再按终结技。上一招消耗术法值，并不保证这招也可用。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.长按普攻: 输出窗口还在、闪能足够时，长按普攻发动这招强化特殊技。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1371: 先看闪能、术法值与玄墨值：下步强化特殊技需要闪能；有玄墨值且要回闪能时长按闪避。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.142100004: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，让重击命中

137100007: 长按普攻就是发动这招强化特殊技的输入。闪能够时直接长按，无需先点普攻或再按特殊技；收束自动发动。
Holding Basic activates this EX. With enough Adrenaline, hold it directly: no preliminary Basic taps or separate Special press. The finisher is automatic.

137100008: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows

1371:opening-ex: 技能原文将续段列在这一招之下：第二段为「霄云迅击-破」，第三段为「青溟震击-破」。
The skill description lists the second and third stages as follow-ups of this same skill.
